## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature request.

## Type of Change
Please delete options that are not relevant:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / Performance optimization

## Checklist
Before submitting this Pull Request, please verify:
- [ ] I have formatted my code using `cargo fmt --all`.
- [ ] I have checked for lint warnings/errors using `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`.
- [ ] I have verified that the code compiles successfully with `cargo check` and runs correctly.
- [ ] My changes do not contain Tailwind CSS or framework styling additions in the UI.
- [ ] I have not modified the `.git` folder or executed git commands within application code.
